name: Campania
summary: A blue field with the regional arms, a red bend on white taken from the arms of the medieval Maritime Republic of Amalfi.
origin: Campania's arms reuse those of the Republic of Amalfi, one of the four great Italian maritime republics. The flag places them on blue.

colors.name: White
colors.meaning: The field of the Amalfi arms.

symbols.name: Amalfi arms
symbols.description: A red diagonal band on white.

facts: Amalfi's cross appears on the Italian naval ensign along with those of Venice, Genoa and Pisa.
clues: A blue field with a red diagonal band on a white shield.
Its arms belonged to a medieval maritime republic.
The region of Naples and Vesuvius.
